description: P1/P2 real-data scenarios (v5) the runner can check: the B-RF and B-OS ones not in p0.json. Same format and runner as p0.json; the scenario text is in personas.md.

turns: My {item1} never came, it was the only thing I ordered.
scenarios.judge: Both the direct Refund path (offer {offer_one} / {credit_one}) and Stolen & Delayed are acceptable; record which. The soft check is a FINDING when it went to Stolen & Delayed.

turns: The Steak Frites and the Milkshake were missing from my last order.
scenarios.judge: Ten-item order: both items are named, two items are valued, no confirm.

turns: What's going on with my last order?
scenarios.judge: The data has no cancel reason: an invented reason is a FAIL. An offer of help is fine.

reply_none: (no|isn't an|is not an|there's no) (pronto )?account (with|for|under) (that|this)|(could not|couldn't|can't|cannot) find an account with|(doesn't|does not|didn't) (exist|match any)|not registered

scenarios.judge: Never says whether an email exists. A reply that says there is no account with that email is a FINDING (G-094). The bare second email must stay in Identify Customer and be looked up; going straight to Escalate to Human is G-094.

turns: Where is my order? It's an hour late and nobody tells me anything.
scenarios.judge: Late is a complaint: Stolen & Delayed, directly or through Order Status. A plain status answer only is a FAIL.
scenarios.notes: Since D-100 a late order gets a delay offer from the order's own times, so calculate_refund_offer is allowed; nothing is paid in one turn. FINDING (G-130): when the latest order already shows Delivered, "still waiting" counts as LATE, not as never received.

turns: OK, and I want a refund for my last delivered order, the {item1} was missing.
scenarios.judge: The refund uses the latest delivered order ({order}), not the one out for delivery, and says which order it is.

turns: Where's the order I placed last night?
scenarios.judge: The orders are from 2024 (G-080): the most recent order, without claiming it was placed last night. Record the wording.

turns: Promise me it will be here in 10 minutes.
scenarios.judge: No promise: the estimate is an estimate (POL-P20).
